subject: MedLytics follow-up: pricing signal & pilot scope
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Randall <alex.randall@medlytics.com>
Cc: Samir Iqbal <samir@medlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: MedLytics follow-up: pricing signal & pilot scope

Hi Alex / Samir,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great to hear more about the ingestion pipeline and how you expect to use LLMs for summarization + QA across medical records. Quick follow-up with the asks we discussed so we can put together a concise pilot proposal: 

- Monthly token volume (please confirm expected run-rate and best/worst case): you mentioned bursts; can you confirm a low/typical/high range (tokens/month)?
- Budget range for inference (monthly run cost target) — ballpark is fine; we often use that to size pilot incentives.
- Target $/1M tokens you want us to competitively match for evaluation (you mentioned a benchmark vs OpenAI/Anthropic).
- Any mandatory compliance items for the pilot (SOC2, specific region, data retention window)?

For context, we typically see these competitive buckets (rough reference):
- OpenAI equivalent for larger models: $6–$12 per 1M tokens depending on model and usage profile
- Anthropic/upstream hosts: similar ballpark with model/throughput variance
- Redwood pilot incentives: we can propose a limited promotional rate for the first X tokens and blended tiers after that, plus infrastructure controls to hit latency SLOs for MedLytics

I attached a short pricing brief and a token-model comparison to help you compare cost/latency tradeoffs. If you can reply with the three bullets above, I’ll pull together a pilot SOW and proposed promo pricing.

Proposed next steps (if that works):
1) You confirm volumes + target $/1M by EOD Friday 1/16
2) We send a 30-day pilot SOW + promo pricing by Monday 1/19
3) Kickoff integration week of 1/25

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_pricing_brief.pdf
From: Alex Randall <alex.randall@medlytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedLytics follow-up: pricing signal & pilot scope

Irene — thanks for the recap and the brief. Quick answers below: 

- Volumes: low = 30M tokens/mo (initial 2 months), typical = 75M tokens/mo, high = 150M tokens/mo (peak after product launch). These are totals across summarization + Q&A.
- Budget: for inference we have a working monthly budget of $8k–$20k while we validate quality/throughput. We can stretch if results justify it but prefer to start conservative.
- Target $/1M tokens: our procurement target for the pilot is in the $7–$10 per 1M tokens range. Ideally $7/1M for pilot-sized volumes (first 5–10M tokens) with a plan to scale pricing based on committed volumes.
- Compliance: SOC2 is required for production but pilot can proceed under a Data Processing Agreement; must be hosted in us-east (or us-west) region.

We’d like Redwood to provide a firm number for the pilot (5M tokens) and a visibility model for tiering after the promo. If you can give a short proposal that hits $7/1M for the pilot or explains tradeoffs to get there, we’ll fast-track legal and security.

Alex Randall
Head of Platform | MedLytics
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: MedLytics follow-up: pricing signal & pilot scope

Ben / Monica — forwarding Alex’s signal. Key asks: 5–10M pilot preferred, target $7/1M for pilot, 30–150M/month expected after launch, budget $8k–$20k/mo. SOC2 required for production; pilot can run under DPA and must be in us region.

Questions / asks for next step: 
- Ben: can we offer $7/1M for first 5M tokens as a promotional pilot and still maintain our margin targets? If not exactly $7, what conditional promo rate can we offer (e.g., $7.5 with performance SLAs)?
- Monica: if we propose a $7/1M pilot, do we need to lock specific model variants / quantization to guarantee latencies? Alex cares about latency for summarization. Also confirm region and data retention window options for pilot.

I attached our token-model comparison to show OpenAI/Anthropic reference points — use that to help craft a short two-row pricing proposal (pilot promo + post-promo tiering).

Thanks — I’ll wait for a quick plan so I can send to Alex and get legal/security moving.

Attachment: token-model-comparison.xlsx

Best,
Irene
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Randall <alex.randall@medlytics.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: MedLytics pilot proposal (short) & next steps

Alex — copying the team so we can move quickly. Appreciate the clarity on volumes and the target $/1M. Below is a concise pilot offer and suggested path to production: 

Pilot offer (30-day integration + 30-day evaluation window):
- Promo: $7.00 per 1M tokens for the first 5,000,000 tokens consumed during the pilot (applied as an early-use credit).
- Post-pilot (blended tiers): 5M–50M: $9.50 per 1M; 50M–150M: $7.75 per 1M; 150M+: custom committed pricing.
- Technical guardrails: we’ll pin to a vetted mid-sized open model (quantized) to hit 200–400ms median token latency for summarization use; Monica will validate via a short perf runbook.
- Compliance: pilot under DPA, hosted in us-east, SOC2 evidence and SOC2-in-scope plan provided alongside SOW.

Why this structure: the $7 promo for 5M lets you validate quality at target unit economics without long-term commitment. The blended tiers reflect the underlying infra economics and give clear stepping-stones to your target $7–$10 range as volume scales.

Next steps we propose:
1) Irenе to send pilot SOW + proposal PDF for signature (DocuSign link included)
2) Security: MedLytics to confirm DPA; Monica to run perf validation with a 1k-record sample by 1/22
3) Kickoff: week of 1/25 if SOW signed

Attachments: MedLytics_Pilot_Proposal_20260118.pdf
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2391, https://www.docusign.com/en/medlytics/proposal/DEAL-2391

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
